behavior: Acquire wins on a free issue and is refused for a second claimant, and the refusal names the holder
verification: cd cli && o=$(mktemp) && go test ./internal/lane/ -run '^(TestClaimAcquire|TestClaimedErrorNamesTheHolder)$' -count=1 -v > "$o" 2>&1 && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestClaimAcquire ' "$o" && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestClaimedErrorNamesTheHolder ' "$o"

behavior: concurrent claims of one issue produce exactly one winner, and the claim ref is invisible to a default clone
verification: cd cli && o=$(mktemp) && go test ./internal/lane/ -run '^(TestClaimConcurrent|TestClaimIsInvisibleToADefaultClone)$' -count=1 -v > "$o" 2>&1 && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestClaimConcurrent ' "$o" && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestClaimIsInvisibleToADefaultClone ' "$o"

behavior: lane next claims before it starts, skips to the next free item on a loss, and starts nothing for the loser
verification: cd cli && o=$(mktemp) && go test ./internal/lane/ -run '^(TestHandoffClaimsBeforeItStarts|TestHandoffSkipsToTheNextFreeItemOnALoss)$' -count=1 -v > "$o" 2>&1 && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestHandoffClaimsBeforeItStarts ' "$o" && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestHandoffSkipsToTheNextFreeItemOnALoss ' "$o"

behavior: lane release deletes the caller's claim, refuses another holder's without --force, and a second release is a no-op
verification: cd cli && o=$(mktemp) && go test ./internal/cmd/ -run '^(TestLaneRelease)$' -count=1 -v > "$o" 2>&1 && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestLaneRelease ' "$o"
